mistake.headline:
Hips sagging
toward the floor.
mistake.body: Your hips drop, your back sags and your body isn't a straight line anymore. Your chest never gets all the way down.

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at the bottom of a push-up, body straight, chest near the mat

fix.headline:
Straight line.
Chest all the way down.
fix.body: Keep your body in a straight line and bring your chest all the way down, slow and controlled. Too hard? [em]Do them from your knees.[/em]

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan kneeling on the mat between sets

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for the push-up
items: Body straight from your head to your heels.
Chest all the way down. Touch your nose to the ground.
Too hard? Do them from your knees, same rules.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy whose hips hit the floor before his chest does.

cta.follow: One fix a week, filmed on me.
